[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35197209/861d7a8715e513fb896ea1735f5a4569dfc6c0c6.jpg[/img]
Anime Expo has came and went, so of course we have something new to share with you! You're all looking forward to the next project from KENZsoft right? Well, so are we! The next project is called "[u][i]The Secret Atelier[/i][/u]" and we're bringing it to the west! It's currently still in development and we don't have an ETA for release at this time. You can follow the developer (@kenzsoft) on Twitter for updates on progress and of course we'll try to keep you updated as well! Like with Super Naughty Maid 2 we will be releasing this title uncensored/no mosaics! We'd love to share with you some samples (and trust us, they look great!), but you'll just have to wait a liiiiittle longer! Hang tight! 

[h1]And here's a small update what's been going on with Super Naughty Maid 2 [/h1]

[b]Cards update[/b] - We released Steam cards recently! We wanted to go a little sexier with Leona, but unfortunately we weren't able to go /too/ sexy... Leona's just too hot for Steam! We hope you enjoy the cards regardless and if you liked those other outfits we'd love to hear your support so we could possibly add new outfits as DLC...? No promises on the DLC part, but we're interested if you're interested~

[b]Subtitles update[/b] - We just finished the translation and editing for the daydream dirty talk dialog! We're still working on implementing that and unfortunately Anime Expo got in the way... and things got delayed... you get the idea. Rest assured we'll try to get that update pushed out to you very soon! Once it's good and ready we'll hit the push build button so you can enjoy her dirty dialog being whispered into your ear!

[h1]Another 3D model game on the way![/h1]

We've teamed up with t japan to bring all three of their releases to the west officially! You may have heard of them before, but here's what they've created: SF - Glass - New Glass. We're going to start working on these very soon! Keep an eye out and look forward to it~ As for some other details: It will be in English and Chinese language and we're still confirming with the dev if the releases will be with or without mosaic. We plan to release the titles from t japan on Denpasoft first.

notes.title: Update 2: Text Encoding Issue
notes.content:
After some more checking, it appears that we've narrowed the issue down a bit more.

At some point in time, Microsoft pushed an update for Windows 10 which includes a new option in the Region Settings:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35197209/410ec2c293711f1dffe2d7b89c392dbe795604f7.jpg[/img]

To access this option in Windows 10, search for Region & language and on the right hand side of the menu you should find the option Administrative language settings. Alternatively you can open up Control Panel, click on Clock and Region followed by Region.

Next, click on Change system locale which will bring you to the above window. Here you can uncheck the Beta: Use Unicode UTF-8 for worldwide language support option.

While the actual issue is still unclear, checking the Beta: Use Unicode UTF-8 for worldwide language support apparently breaks the game regardless of the locale that's used. Until a proper fix is made either in the game engine or in Microsoft's implementation we recommend unchecking this option which should allow Super Naughty Maid 2 to run fine. It's still unclear if this will fix things for everyone but it's definitely one possibility.

We appreciate everyone's patience and continued support.

notes.title: Update: Text Encoding Issue
notes.content:
Super Naughty Maid 2 has been updated to address an encoding issue where users in certain locales cannot run the game and get a garbled error message.

Your game should already be patched but if you haven't already done so, go ahead and update your game.

Thank you for your patience and continued support.

notes.title: Update for Super Naughty Maid 2
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we wanted to let you know that we will now be offering a mosaic and mosaic free* version of [i]Super Naughty Maid 2[/i] on Steam. This is to allow fans in Japan as well as fans who may prefer mosaic with English text to be able to enjoy this release on Steam. So what does that mean? We will be offering a FREE no mosaic update DLC on Steam (available at launch). This no mosaic DLC is ONLY available to users located outside of Japan. The Denpasoft version of [i]Super Naughty Maid 2[/i] is mosaic free by default with no need to download any DLCs. We hope all you fans of KENZsoft out there will enjoy this release! Thank you for your understanding.

[b]*Mosaic free versions are only available OUTSIDE OF JAPAN/FOR NON JAPANESE USERS.[/b]
